state notes=[{"id":"n1","title":"Morning pages","body":"Woke before the light and wrote three pages by hand. The trick is not to reread them.\n\nThe quiet hour is the only one that belongs to me.","nb":"j24","tags":["journal","habit"],"pinned":true,"created":"2026-11-02","edited":"2026-11-15","trashed":false},{"id":"n2","title":"Q4 planning notes","body":"Three bets for the quarter: onboarding, offline mode, and the export format.\n\nOpen question: who owns the migration?","nb":"proj","tags":["work","planning"],"pinned":false,"created":"2026-10-28","edited":"2026-11-14","trashed":false},{"id":"n3","title":"On Marginalia","body":"Notes on reading with a pencil: underline sparingly, argue in the margin, and return a year later.","nb":"read","tags":["reading","habit"],"pinned":false,"created":"2026-09-12","edited":"2026-11-10","trashed":false},{"id":"n4","title":"Sourdough, third attempt","body":"900g flour, 700g water, 20g salt, 180g starter. Fold every thirty minutes for three hours.","nb":"recipes","tags":["recipes","baking"],"pinned":false,"created":"2026-11-01","edited":"2026-11-09","trashed":false},{"id":"n5","title":"Meeting with Priya","body":"She wants the draft by Friday. Send the outline first and ask about the budget line.","nb":"proj","tags":["work"],"pinned":false,"created":"2026-11-05","edited":"2026-11-08","trashed":false},{"id":"n6","title":"Old shopping list","body":"Oats, lemons, candles, stamps.","nb":"journal","tags":[],"pinned":false,"created":"2026-08-03","edited":"2026-08-03","trashed":true}] persist
state theme="Paper" persist
state fontSize=18 persist
state sort="Edited" persist
state nb="all" persist
state openId="n1" persist
state pane="list"
state folded=[] persist
state q=""
state selecting=false
state picked=[]
state saved=true
state tagDraft=""
state tag=""
state view="workspace"
state expandedNb={}
Shortcut "mod+k" onPress={open palette}
Shortcut "mod+n" onPress={notes=append(notes,{"id":"n"+(length(notes)+1),"title":"Untitled","body":"","nb":nb=="all"?"journal":nb,"tags":[],"pinned":false,"created":today(),"edited":today(),"trashed":false}); openId="n"+(length(notes)+1); pane="note"}
App
  Sidebar w=240 border-right=#FFE3D9C3 fill=#FFF3EBDA show=desktop
    Brand "Inkwell" icon="auto_stories"
    Button "New note" icon="add" onTap={emit newNote}
    Input "Search" "Ctrl K" icon="search" readonly onTap={open palette}
    Text.caption "NOTEBOOKS"
    Tree items={notebooks} @nb parent="parent" foldable foldedBind=folded label="name" count={n=>count(notes,x=>!x.trashed && (n.id=="all" || x.nb==n.id))} onSelect={nb=result; view="workspace"; pane="list"}
    Divider
    NavItem "Tags" icon="sell" selected={view=="tags"} onTap={view="tags"}
    NavItem "Trash" icon="delete" badge="{count(notes,x=>x.trashed)}" selected={view=="trash"} onTap={view="trash"}
    NavItem "Settings" icon="settings" selected={view=="settings"} onTap={view="settings"}
    Spacer grow
    Text.caption "{count(notes,x=>!x.trashed)} notes"
  Main
    Nav show=phone
      IconButton "menu" onTap={open nbSheet}
      Heading "Inkwell" level=3
      Row gap=4
        IconButton "search" onTap={open palette}
        IconButton "add" onTap={emit newNote}
    Splitter#panes
      Pane w=340 minw=260 resizable show={view=="workspace" && (pane=="list" || !phone)}
        Nav
          Heading "{first(map(filter(notebooks,x=>x.id==nb),x=>x.name))}" level=3
          Row gap=4
            Select @sort items=["Edited","Created","Title"] w=110
            IconButton "checklist" onTap={selecting=!selecting; picked=[]}
        if selecting
          Row gap=8 pad=8 fill=#FFEFE4CC
            Text.small "{length(picked)} selected"
            Spacer grow
            Button.ghost "Move" icon="drive_file_move" onTap={open moveMenu}
            Button.ghost "Tag" icon="sell" onTap={open tagPopover}
            Button.ghost "Delete" icon="delete" onTap={open confirmMany}
        if count(notes,x=>!x.trashed && (nb=="all" || x.nb==nb))==0
          EmptyState "This notebook is empty" "Start with a blank page." icon="edit_note"
            Button "New note" onTap={emit newNote}
        ListView scroll
          each n in sortBy(sortByDesc(filter(notes,x=>!x.trashed && (nb=="all" || x.nb==nb)),x=>sort=="Title"?0:(sort=="Created"?x.created:x.edited)),x=>x.pinned?0:1)
            ListTile selected={openId==n.id} onTap={openId=n.id; pane="note"} onLongPress={selecting=true; picked=append(picked,n.id)} menu=noteMenu
              if selecting
                Checkbox @picked value={n.id}
              Column gap=2 grow
                Row gap=6
                  if n.pinned
                    Icon "push_pin" size=14
                  Text.strong "{n.title}"
                Text.muted "{slice(n.body,0,70)}"
                Row gap=4
                  Text.caption "{formatDate(n.edited,"MMM d")}"
                  each t in n.tags
                    Chip "{t}" size=small
      Pane grow show={view=="workspace" && (pane=="note" || !phone)}
        Nav show=phone
          IconButton "arrow_back" onTap={pane="list"}
          Heading "Note" level=3
        Column pad=32 gap=12 maxw=760 scroll
          Row between
            Input.plain "Title" @find(notes,x=>x.id==openId).title size=28 font="serif" weight=700 onChange={saved=false; notes=updateWhere(notes,x=>x.id==openId,x=>with(x,"edited",today()))} debounce=600 onSaved={saved=true}
            Row gap=8
              if saved
                Row gap=4
                  Icon "check" size=14 color=#FF8A6A3D
                  Text.caption "Saved"
              if !saved
                Text.caption "Saving..."
              Toggle "Pin" @find(notes,x=>x.id==openId).pinned
              IconButton "folder_open" onTap={open moveNote}
              IconButton "delete" onTap={open confirmOne}
          Row gap=6 wrap
            each t in find(notes,x=>x.id==openId).tags
              Chip "{t}" removable onRemove={notes=updateWhere(notes,x=>x.id==openId,x=>with(x,"tags",without(x.tags,t)))}
            Autocomplete "Add tag" @tagDraft suggestions={unique(concat(["journal","work","reading","recipes","planning","habit","baking"],[]))} w=160 onSubmit={notes=updateWhere(notes,x=>x.id==openId,x=>with(x,"tags",unique(append(x.tags,lower(result))))); tagDraft=""}
          Input.plain "Start writing..." multiline autogrow @find(notes,x=>x.id==openId).body font="serif" size={fontSize} lineHeight=1.7 onChange={saved=false} debounce=600 onSaved={saved=true}
          Text.caption "{length(filter(split(find(notes,x=>x.id==openId).body," "),w=>w!=""))} words"
      Main grow show={view=="tags"}
        Column pad=24 gap=16
          Heading "Tags" level=1
          Row gap=8 wrap
            each t in unique(concat(map(notes,x=>x.tags[0]),[]))
              ChoiceChip "{t} {count(notes,x=>!x.trashed && contains(x.tags,t))}" selected={tag==t} onTap={tag=t}
          if tag!=""
            Heading "Notes tagged {tag}" level=3
            each n in filter(notes,x=>!x.trashed && contains(x.tags,tag))
              ListTile "{n.title}" subtitle="{formatDate(n.edited,"MMM d")}" onTap={openId=n.id; view="workspace"; pane="note"}
  Dialog#confirmOne "Move to trash?" "The note can be restored from the trash."
    Row end gap=8
      Button.ghost "Cancel" onTap={close}
      Button.destructive "Move to trash" onTap={notes=updateWhere(notes,x=>x.id==openId,x=>with(x,"trashed",true)); toast "Moved to trash"; close}
  Dialog#confirmMany "Delete {length(picked)} notes?" "They go to the trash."
    Row end gap=8
      Button.ghost "Cancel" onTap={close}
      Button.destructive "Delete" onTap={notes=map(notes,x=>contains(picked,x.id)?with(x,"trashed",true):x); picked=[]; selecting=false; close}
  Menu#moveNote
    each b in notebooks
      MenuItem "{b.name}" icon="folder" onTap={notes=updateWhere(notes,x=>x.id==openId,x=>with(x,"nb",b.id)); toast "Moved to {b.name}"}
  Menu#moveMenu
    each b in notebooks
      MenuItem "{b.name}" icon="folder" onTap={notes=map(notes,x=>contains(picked,x.id)?with(x,"nb",b.id):x); picked=[]; selecting=false}
  Popover#tagPopover
    Autocomplete "Tag" @tagDraft suggestions=["journal","work","reading","recipes","planning","habit","baking"] onSubmit={notes=map(notes,x=>contains(picked,x.id)?with(x,"tags",unique(append(x.tags,lower(result)))):x); tagDraft=""; picked=[]; selecting=false; close}
  Menu#noteMenu
    MenuItem "Pin" icon="push_pin" onTap={notes=updateWhere(notes,x=>x.id==openId,x=>with(x,"pinned",!x.pinned))}
    MenuItem "Move to..." icon="drive_file_move" onTap={open moveNote}
    MenuItem "Delete" icon="delete" onTap={open confirmOne}
  Sheet#nbSheet "Notebooks"
    Tree items={notebooks} @nb parent="parent" foldable foldedBind=folded label="name" onSelect={nb=result; view="workspace"; pane="list"; close}
    NavItem "Tags" icon="sell" onTap={view="tags"; close}
    NavItem "Trash" icon="delete" onTap={view="trash"; close}
    NavItem "Settings" icon="settings" onTap={view="settings"; close}
### tool/vocabulary/corpus/2026-11-16-sonnet/answers/calendar-app.txt ### Calendars
state hiddenCals=[] persist
state cals=[{"id":"work","name":"Work","color":"#FF2563EB","count":14},{"id":"home","name":"Home","color":"#FF16A34A","count":5},{"id":"family","name":"Family","color":"#FFDB2777","count":7},{"id":"health","name":"Health","color":"#FFEA580C","count":3},{"id":"travel","name":"Travel","color":"#FF7C3AED","count":2},{"id":"focus","name":"Focus","color":"#FF0891B2","count":9}]
App
  Sidebar w=260 hide=tablet
    Brand "Margin" icon="calendar_month"
    NavItem "Back to calendar" icon="arrow_back" onTap={go month}
  Main
    Nav border-bottom=#FFE5E7EB
      Heading "Calendars" level=3
    Column pad=24 gap=12 maxw=560
      Text.muted "Switch a calendar off to hide its events everywhere. Your choice is remembered."
      each c in cals
        Card
          Row gap=12 middle
            Box w=14 h=14 radius=7 fill={c.color}
            Column grow
              Text.strong c.name
              Text.caption "{c.count} events"
            Toggle value={!contains(hiddenCals,c.id)} onChange={hiddenCals=result?without(hiddenCals,c.id):append(hiddenCals,c.id)}
